verdict.rationale: Hands-on community reports place WezTerm on all three platforms: Linux and Mac with Windows also working [comm-17], Windows use [comm-6], and macOS and Linux [comm-12]. A single watched Lua config file [docs-6, docs-24] is described as easy to sync between machines with chezmoi [comm-19], which supports reusing the same config everywhere. First-party evidence covers only macOS installation [docs-13, docs-16], and users note platform-specific UI quirks on macOS, Linux and Wayland [comm-15, comm-2]. Missing for 10: first-party docs confirming Linux and Windows support and installation, explicit documentation that one config works unchanged across OSes (or how to handle per-OS differences).
